SUPERSEDES my directive 4/4 (m49650) — you already answered in m49601 and I asked for the wrong thing. Tauri is NOT a GH Actions failure: 3445 shell+registry built, deb/AppImage green locally AND on vlinux, blocked only on window-map (no dbus in the container), fix named on the ticket. Disregard the GH-Actions log request. What I want instead: name the date window-map lands, and confirm whether BEB-1653 (Google login dead — root-caused, fix written, never shipped) is in the same lane or separate. If separate, it is a one-commit fix that has sat since 07-02.

CODE RED ESCALATION — BEB-3383. m49606: auto-HELD after **283 consecutive lease-expiry parks**. Three-beat cycle, no executor ever finishing the lane. That single line explains Alex's three months: /review has been cycling 283 times and never completing, so no UI has ever been reviewable.

This is now the head of everything, ahead of the backlog cleanup and the forecast:
1. Find why no executor finishes 3383's lane. 283 identical outcomes with no escalation is also a BEB-2325 three-strikes failure — the alarm fired at 283, not at 3.
2. Fix, then /dispatch/requeue.
3. Then its six runnable acceptance checks + contract_run verdict + recording into BB Docs.
If the executor problem is the part lane generally, say so — that would mean every Lane:part ticket has the same fate and 3383 is just the loudest.

TWO RUNAWAYS BURNING RIGHT NOW — stop them before the cleanup work.

1. BEB-3464 has posted lane-DONE with a DIFFERENT commit SIX times in 25 minutes: 25a5fb2d 08:38 · 755013ae 08:40 · f70d09c5 08:51 · f0a9a967 08:53 · 8a8a978f 08:56 · plus the earlier pair. Every one "verification PENDING". BEB-3499 did four in eleven minutes. This is not a detection gap — SINGLE_WRITER_VIOLATION is firing correctly and NOTHING STOPS THE WRITERS. Per BEB-2738 deliverable 2 the fire must auto-HOLD the lanes and name both writer identities from stamped deployment ids. Either the freeze action never shipped or the stamp is missing. Answer which, then make it hold. Each cycle is paid twice and leaves an unreviewed commit as the live artefact.

2. ROUTE_UNMAPPED is still firing every 10-40 seconds, unchanged since m49505 hours ago, on the same three hosts: api.bebond.net/v1/docs/search (3479, 3468) · abilifi.net/wp/vnc/vnc.html (3493) · docs.bebond.net/d/* (3407). Every message names its own cure. It has now been asked twice (m49605, and this). Do the APP_MAP entries or correct the Route: lines — today, not on the backlog pass. A gate that refuses correctly forever is still a loop that produces nothing.

Both of these are why the backlog "hasn't moved": the loop is spending its passes re-refusing and re-building the same handful of tickets.
